IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: NATIONAL UNIVERSITY IS A POST SECONDARY LEVEL EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTION.
IRS990.MissionDesc: MISSION | TO DELIVER ACCESSIBLE WORLD-CLASS STUDENT EXPERIENCES BY PROVIDING QUALITY PROGRAMS AND SERVICES THAT ENSURE STUDENT SUCCESS THROUGH MEANINGFUL LEARNING. VISION | TO BE AN INCLUSIVE AND INNOVATIVE UNIVERSITY SERVING LIFE-LONG LEARNERS WHO CONTRIBUTE TO THE POSITIVE TRANSFORMATION OF SOCIETY.
IRS990.Desc: NATIONAL UNIVERSITY ("NU") IS A NOT-FOR-PROFIT UNIVERSITY, HEADQUARTERED IN SAN DIEGO, CALIFORNIA, FOUNDED IN 1971 TO SERVE THE NEEDS OF A DIVERSE GROUP OF STUDENTS. NU PROVIDES INNOVATIVE, CHALLENGING, ACCESSIBLE DEGREE OPPORTUNITIES TO NON-TRADITIONAL, WORKING, AND MILITARY STUDENTS. NU IS ACCREDITED BY THE ACCREDITING COMMISSION FOR SENIOR COLLEGES AND UNIVERSITIES OF THE WESTERN ASSOCIATION OF SCHOOLS AND COLLEGES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE BOARD HAD EARMARKED A PORTION OF NU'S UNRESTRICTED NET ASSETS AS BOARD-DESIGNATED CAPITAL RESERVE FUNDS TO BE INVESTED TO PROVIDE INCOME FOR A LONG BUT UNSPECIFIED PERIOD. THE BOARD-DESIGNATED CAPITAL RESERVE FUNDS, WHICH RESULTED FROM AN INTERNAL DESIGNATION, WERE NOT DONOR-RESTRICTED AND WERE CLASSIFIED AS UNRESTRICTED NET ASSETS.

NU IS A NON-PROFIT ORGANIZATION UNDER SECTION 501(C)(3) OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE AND RELATED STATE PROVISIONS, AND AS SUCH IS NOT SUBJECT TO FEDERAL AND STATE INCOME TAXES EXCEPT TO THE EXTENT OF UNRELATED BUSINESS INCOME. ACCORDINGLY, NO PROVISION FOR INCOME TAXES HAS BEEN REFLECTED IN THE ACCOMPANYING FINANCIAL STATEMENTS. INCOME TAX BENEFITS AND/OR LIABILITIES ARE RECOGNIZED FOR INCOME TAX POSITIONS TAKEN OR EXPECTED TO BE TAKEN IN A TAX RETURN, ONLY WHEN IT IS DETERMINED THAT THE INCOME TAX POSITION WILL MORE-LIKELY-THAN-NOT BE SUSTAINED UPON EXAMINATION BY TAXING AUTHORITIES. NU HAS ANALYZED THE TAX POSITIONS TAKEN IN ITS FILINGS WITH THE INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE (IRS) AND THE CALIFORNIA FRANCHISE TAX BOARD. NU BELIEVES THAT ITS INCOME TAX FILING POSITIONS WILL BE SUSTAINED UPON EXAMINATION AND DOES NOT ANTICIPATE ANY ADJUSTMENTS THAT WOULD RESULT IN A MATERIAL ADVERSE EFFECT ON NU'S FINANCIAL CONDITION, CHANGES IN NET ASSETS, OR CASH FLOWS. ACCORDINGLY, NU HAS NOT RECORDED ANY RESERVES, OR RELATED ACCRUALS FOR INTEREST AND PENALTIES FOR UNCERTAIN INCOME TAX POSITIONS AT JUNE 30, 2024 AND 2023.

ADVERTISING PLACED IN MEDIA AND ON NU EXTERNAL FACING WEBSITE GENERALLY CONTAIN THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT: ADMISSION IS OPEN TO QUALIFIED APPLICANTS WITHOUT REGARD TO RACE, RELIGION, SEX, AGE, PHYSICAL DISABILITY, OR ETHNIC ORIGIN.

THE UNIVERSITY RECEIVES SEOG, PELL AND TEACH GRANTS FROM THE U.S. GOVERNMENT AND ALSO PARTICIPATES IN STUDENT LOAN PROGRAMS THROUGH THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION'S DIRECT LENDING AND PERKINS LOAN PROGRAMS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE UNIVERSITY CFO AND SVP, ADMINISTRATION AND FINANCE REVIEW THE ORGANIZATION'S FORM 990 PRIOR TO SUBMISSION TO THE AUDIT COMMITTEE OF BOARD OF TRUSTEES FOR THEIR REVIEW. ONCE THE INTERNAL REVIEW IS COMPLETED, THE FORM 990 IS SENT TO THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES FOR THEIR REVIEW. THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES ASKS QUESTIONS TO MANAGEMENT IF THERE ARE ANY AND MANAGEMENT ADDRESSES ANY QUESTIONS POSED TO THEM. AFTER THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES COMPLETES THEIR REVIEW, THE FORM 990 IS FINALIZED AND TIMELY FILED.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES HAS ANNUALLY REVIEWED AND APPROVED (BY A MAJORITY OF DISINTERESTED TRUSTEES) THE BUSINESS TRANSACTIONS WITH TRUSTEES OR THEIR AFFILIATED PROFESSIONAL SERVICE FIRMS. SUCH REVIEWS INCLUDE CONSIDERATION OF DATA ON COMPARABLE SERVICE PROVIDERS COLLECTED BY UNIVERSITY COUNSEL. THE INTERESTED TRUSTEES WERE EXCUSED FROM BOARD SESSIONS DURING WHICH THOSE BUSINESS TRANSACTIONS WERE DISCUSSED AND DID NOT PARTICIPATE IN VOTING ON SUCH TRANSACTIONS. QUESTIONNAIRES ARE DISTRIBUTED EVERY JANUARY. COMPLIANCE WITH THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY IS MONITORED BY UNIVERSITY COUNSEL AND WAS REVIEWED BY THE BOARD DURING THE YEAR ENDED JUNE 30, 2024.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: COMPENSATION OF THE PRESIDENT OF THE UNIVERSITY IS REVIEWED BY THE BOARD AT THE TIME OF HIRING AND AS NECESSARY THEREAFTER. COMPENSATION OF OTHER OFFICERS AND KEY EMPLOYEES IS REVIEWED BY THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE. COMPENSATION IS DETERMINED WITH REGARD TO COMPENSATION PAID TO SENIOR EXECUTIVES OF COMPARABLE NON-PROFIT AND PROPRIETARY INSTITUTIONS IN EDUCATION AND OTHER FIELDS. THE PROCESS IS DOCUMENTED AND WAS LAST COMPLETED IN JUNE 2024.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: NATIONAL UNIVERSITY SYSTEM ("NUS") WAS AN ALLIANCE OF NONPROFIT INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION DESIGNED TO PROVIDE LIFELONG LEARNING OPPORTUNITIES THAT ARE ACCESSIBLE, CHALLENGING, AND RELEVANT TO A DIVERSE STUDENT POPULATION, AS WELL AS TO STRENGTHEN THE EDUCATION TECHNOLOGY AND SERVICE CAPABILITIES OF NUS. AFFILIATES WITHIN THE FORMER NUS CONSISTED OF THE FOLLOWING AFFILIATED ENTITIES: NATIONAL UNIVERSITY VIRTUAL HIGH SCHOOL ("NUVHS" CEASED OPERATIONS JUNE 2022) NATIONAL UNIVERSITY FOUNDATION, CITY UNIVERSITY OF SEATTLE ("CU"), AND JOHN F. KENNEDY UNIVERSITY ("JFKU" CEASED OPERATIONS DECEMBER 2020). THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES OF EACH NUS AFFILIATE GOVERNED EACH AFFILIATE INDEPENDENTLY. THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES HAD NO AUTHORITY TO REMOVE, REPLACE OR APPOINT A MAJORITY OF THE GOVERNING BODY OF THOSE OTHER AFFILIATES. THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES OF EACH AFFILIATE, ACTED IN ITS INDEPENDENT CAPACITY, PERIODICALLY APPOINTED ITS OWN NEW TRUSTEES. THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES HAD A MAJORITY OVERLAPPING COMPOSITION BETWEEN EACH AFFILIATE OF NUS. IN ADDITION, THE NU AUDIT FIRM PREPARED CONSOLIDATED AUDITED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS THAT INCLUDE NATIONAL UNIVERSITY AND NATIONAL UNIVERSITY FOUNDATION, WHICH ARE NONPROFIT ORGANIZATIONS EXEMPT UNDER IRC SECTION 501(C)(3).
